history.body: Hi, I’m actively buying and shortlisting homes around Seberang Jaya. I’ve toured another project, but its layout felt compact. What would give me a concrete reason to see Pearl Residences instead? I also saw a dated starting-price reference of around RM302k, which may be within our range.

A concrete point to compare is how the 900 sq ft Type A uses its space: the plan avoids a long internal corridor, with open-plan living, dining and kitchen areas plus a small storage area. That may leave less space taken up by circulation, though the best comparison is against the layout you toured. Since layout is your concern, you could judge it directly from Pearl’s plan or during a viewing—happy to help arrange one if useful. I wouldn’t treat the dated ~RM302k reference as a confirmed current price; the latest unit and package figures need checking.

That’s a useful comparison point—the long corridor in the other place did make it feel cramped. I’d be open to seeing Pearl’s layout in person, but could you send the floor plan first so I can compare them side by side? I’d also need the current unit price confirmed before making plans.

That makes sense—the layout avoids a long internal corridor, so it’s a useful point to compare with the home you toured. I’ll request the Type A floor plan for a side-by-side look. The current unit-price confirmation is still pending, so I can’t confirm whether the ~RM302k reference applies. Once you’ve compared the plan and have the confirmed price, you can decide whether an in-person viewing is worthwhile.
